automatedComment.message: Copying the base map and calling set only for changed projects loses the server's stable project ordering. If a base snapshot contains /z/tsconfig.json and an update adds /a/tsconfig.json, the server orders projects as [a, z], but this map yields [z, a]; equivalent snapshots can therefore return different getProjects() orders based on update history. Preserve the complete ordered project-ID list in the response (or otherwise rebuild this map in ProjectCollection.Projects() order).

In LSP mode, Session.APIUpdate adopts the clone before returning apiError, while handleGetCurrentLanguageServerSnapshot skips update.commit on that error. Validate every failure-producing request before applying mutations, or avoid adopting a clone when HandleAPIRequest fails.

Ensure matching synthetic project IDs in that request (and any other path that consumes all projects without per-project refresh), or exclude synthetic projects from this enumeration.

Reconcile closes and opens against one evolving temporary state, then commit that final state only after the update succeeds.

This issue also appears on line 1241 of the same file.
